failList.Title: The environment-delta integration assertion does not own its baseline
failList.Defect: ExtractEnvironment_RemovesServiceDefaultsAndKeepsExplicitDeltas inherits the parent environment, sets only the child GH_TOKEN to the literal test-token, and indexes deltas["GH_TOKEN"]. ExtractEnvironment compares the child map with Environment.GetEnvironmentVariables and omits equal values. If the parent GH_TOKEN is already test-token, the key is absent and the assertion fails. The test neither sets and restores that baseline nor joins the process-environment collection. Integration classification alone does not fulfill the settled set-and-restore rule.
failList.Fix: Own and restore the relevant baseline under the existing serialized process-environment collection, or expose an explicit baseline-map seam and retain a native binding that owns its baseline. Preserve the unchanged-variable and changed-variable assertions. Amend the plan, self-review and D-B evidence to acknowledge and close the gap before marking either criterion satisfied.

failList.Title: The shared temporary instance does not enforce ownership of its database selection
failList.Defect: ScratchQBrainAi launches a server with the inherited process environment, writes an owned SQLite DataSource to YAML and sets the legacy MCP_SQLITE_DATA_SOURCE variable. It does not remove or override inherited Mcp__Database__Sqlite__ConnectionString or the canonical QBrainAi form. Program loads environment configuration after YAML; ResolveSqliteConnectionString prefers ConnectionString to DataSource. A valid inherited connection string selecting another database therefore wins over the owned file. Workspace/marker argument checks and a health nonce do not check this database selection. The server can use an unowned database or fail startup because of inherited configuration.
failList.Fix: Make the owned-instance configuration authoritative for storage and the related workspace/marker destinations, removing or overriding all competing canonical and legacy inputs, or reject a destination outside the owned context before starting the process. Add a pure configuration-selection contract, its scripted negative controls and the production binding. Reconcile the plan, self-review, TODO closure and D-B before satisfying AC-6 or the integration environment-isolation criteria.
